headline: Broad growth and margin gains; buyback upsized
summary_short: Revenue rose 19% y/y to $3,786M and non-GAAP EPS jumped 35% to $4.20, with non-GAAP operating margin up 330bp to 37.1%. Q4 revenue is guided to $3.75B-$3.95B.
summary_long: Automotive revenue grew 13% to $2,070M, Industrial & IoT 39% to $802M, Communication Infrastructure & Other 54% to $503M, while Mobile fell 4% to $411M. Free cash flow was 31.9% of revenue. NXP returned $359M, with $256M in dividends and $103M of buybacks, and the board authorized a further $5B repurchase program on top of $1.3B remaining. Q4 non-GAAP EPS is guided to $4.14-$4.58.
confidence_notes: Non-GAAP measures exclude acquisition-related amortization, share-based compensation and other items per the release. Margin delta computed from 37.1% vs 33.8% in the release.

drivers.explanation: Accelerating contributions from automotive and industrial growth drivers and continued momentum in data center infrastructure, per the CEO.
Non-GAAP gross margin rose to 58.6% from 57.0% a year ago on higher volume; operating income grew 31% against 19% revenue growth.
CEO points to software-defined vehicles, data center infrastructure and Trusted Physical AI as long-term demand vectors.
